# Discussions (enable in GitHub repo settings)

Suggested categories after the repository is published:

| Category | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| Q&A | Usage and setup help |
| Show and tell | Missions, packs, experiments |
| RFCs | Design discussion before / alongside `RFC/` PRs |
| Pack ideas | Soft proposals before a Pack request issue |

Milestones to create on GitHub:

1. `0.2 OSS foundation`
2. `0.3 Reproducible packs`
3. `0.4 Public beta`

Branch protection (Settings → Branches → `main`):

- Require status checks: CI lint/test jobs
- Require 1 approving review when collaborators join (solo maintainer may skip initially)
- Disallow force pushes
- Prefer linear history
